title: the recipes' pools as the generator writes them (Combat; tools/movegen)
description: pools.json, written by tools/movegen/movegen.mjs from the moveset files by the rules in cells.json `pools`: `rules` (the pool names it writes, in order) and `pools`, a fighter to a pool to a list of {id, status}. The pools block is the shape of data/combat/recipes.json `pools` (tools/schemas/combat-recipes.schema.json): the same names, the same rows, so it can replace those pools as it stands. Cross-checks (coverage.md, in --check): every piece of a live brawl pool is in the generated pool; no id twice in a pool. Policy: closed, except keys starting with an underscore.
